description: This file is a shell script designed to test the behavior of 'git rebase' with incompatible options. It sets up a git repository state, defines a test function to check various rebase options, and runs multiple test cases to ensure rebase aborts or warns correctly when incompatible flags are used.

methods.name: test_rebase_am_only
methods.description: Function to test that certain 'git rebase' options are incompatible with other rebase options, and that the rebase command fails as expected with appropriate messages.
